items.title: General Dynamics (GD) Tops Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: General Dynamics (GD) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +7.34% and +4.48%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: General Dynamics (NYSE:GD) Reports Strong Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Aerospace and defense company General Dynamics (NYSE:GD) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 8.1% year on year to $14.09 billion. Its GAAP profit of $4.24 per share was 6.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: General Dynamics Posts Higher Profit, Revenue
items.summary: General Dynamics reported higher profit and revenue in the second quarter, as performance improved across all of the company’s lines of business.

items.title: General Dynamics Stock Bucks Defense Sector Slump Following Earnings Beat
items.summary: General Dynamics  has managed to avoid much of the defense stock pain that came after fighting began in Iran.  Wall Street was looking for earnings per share of $3.96 from sales of $13.5 billion.  Operating profit margin was 10.4%, up 0.4 percentage point year-over-year.

items.title: General Dynamics posts higher quarterly profit on aerospace and marine strength
items.summary: July 29 (Reuters) - General Dynamics on Wednesday posted a rise in second- quarter profit, driven by continued strength in its aerospace and marine segments.
